data.title: 中野四叶 · 清晨露天风吕的澄澈池畔
data.description: 清晨山间露天温泉白雾轻扬，四叶双臂轻掩胸前，赤足轻踏在温热的泉水边。晨光漫过竹林，映衬着她纯净羞怯的动人面庞。
data.action: soaking in hot spring, arms crossed over chest, steam rising, deep blush
data.lighting: crisp morning mountain sunlight through bamboo trees
data.promptProse: Bathed in the morning mist of a secluded mountain hot spring, Nakano Yotsuba rests in the crystal-clear steaming water with a white bath towel wrapped around her body. Sunlight sparkles on the droplets sliding down her bare shoulders as she blushes innocently, covering her chest with shy modesty.
data.animaCaption: Stepping into the clear morning hot spring with crossed arms, steam rises around her blushing face in the sunlight.
